title: Centro-sectional measures for log-concave functions
summary: We introduce centro-sectional measures with parameters q,m for log-concave functions on Rn, defined in terms of the q-th moments of their Radon transforms with respect to the Haar measure on m-dimensional subspaces, where m=1,...,n-1, and establish the corresponding variational formulas. Our measures generalize the notion of dual curvature measure if q=1, and are related to the Sine transform if q=2.
